books.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
books.author: J.K. Rowling
books.original: As you know, Harry potter series is very famous. It made into movie and that became really famous, too. Most people love Harry potter series. Including me. I read these books at least 3times. It can be little bit scary for young people. (Like 5or 6) But It wasn't scary for me, so I can enjoy reading this series. The story of this book is Harry potter, the boy who live, didn't know he is a wizard, his parents were wizard. But when Hagrid arrived to Dursely's house, he finally knew it. And he want to Hogwarts and getting adjust there. I very respect J.k. Rowling, (author of Harry potter series) because there will be not Hogwart and wizard world if she didn't write this story.
books.corrected: As you know, the Harry Potter series is very famous. It was made into movies, and they became really famous, too. Most people love the Harry Potter series, including me. I have read these books at least 3 times. They can be a little bit scary for very young children (like 5 or 6 years old), but they weren't scary for me, so I could enjoy reading this series. This book is about Harry Potter, the boy who lived, who didn't know he was a wizard even though his parents were wizards. But when Hagrid arrived at the Dursleys' house, he finally found out. Then he went to Hogwarts and got used to life there. I really respect J.K. Rowling (the author of the Harry Potter series) because there would be no Hogwarts and no wizarding world if she hadn't written this story.

corrections.explain: 시리즈 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰고, 이름은 대문자로 시작해요.
‘영화로 만들어졌다’는 수동태 was made예요.
Including me는 혼자 문장이 될 수 없어서 앞 문장에 쉼표로 붙여요.

corrections.corrected: I have read these books at least 3 times
corrections.explain: 몇 번 읽었다는 경험은 have read로, 숫자와 times는 띄어 써요.
corrections.original: I read these books at least 3times

corrections.explain: ‘조금’은 a little bit이에요.
앞 문장이 과거(wasn't)라서 could로 맞춰요.

corrections.corrected: This book is about Harry Potter
corrections.explain: ‘이 책은 ~에 관한 이야기다’는 This book is about ~ 이 자연스러워요.
corrections.original: The story of this book is Harry potter

corrections.explain: ‘살아남은 아이’라는 과거의 일이라 lived예요.

corrections.corrected: didn't know he was a wizard
corrections.explain: 앞이 과거라서 뒤도 was로 맞춰요.
corrections.original: didn't know he is a wizard

corrections.explain: 부모님은 두 명이라 wizards예요.
arrive는 to가 아니라 at과 함께 써요. 더즐리 가족 집은 the Dursleys'예요.
‘드디어 알게 되었다’는 found out이 자연스러워요.

corrections.corrected: he went to Hogwarts and got used to life there
corrections.explain: ‘갔다’는 went예요(want는 ‘원하다’). 적응했다는 got used to예요.
corrections.original: he want to Hogwarts and getting adjust there

corrections.explain: 동사를 꾸밀 때는 very 대신 really를 써요.

corrections.corrected: there would be no Hogwarts and no wizarding world if she hadn't written
corrections.explain: ‘만약 ~하지 않았다면 없었을 거야’는 would + if ~ hadn't 로 써요.
corrections.original: there will be not Hogwart and wizard world if she didn't write

books.strengths: 책의 줄거리를 짧고 정확하게 정리했고, 마지막에 작가를 존경하는 이유로 자기 생각을 분명하게 마무리했어요.
books.tips: 세 번이나 읽었으니, 다시 읽을 때마다 새로 발견한 점을 하나 써 보면 훨씬 깊이 있는 독후감이 돼요.

expressions.en: I've read it three times, and I still love it.
expressions.ko: 세 번 읽었는데도 여전히 좋아요.

expressions.en: The story is about a boy who finds out he is a wizard.
expressions.ko: 자신이 마법사라는 걸 알게 되는 소년의 이야기예요.

expressions.en: Without J.K. Rowling, there would be no Hogwarts.
expressions.ko: J.K. 롤링이 없었다면 호그와트도 없었을 거예요.

books.summary: 마법 세계를 만든 작가에 대한 존경

areas.comment: ‘유명한 책 → 내가 읽은 경험 → 줄거리 → 작가를 존경하는 이유’ 순서로 흐름이 아주 잘 짜였어요.
areas.name: 구성

areas.comment: 해리가 마법사인 걸 알게 되고 호그와트에 가는 핵심만 짧고 정확하게 소개했어요.
areas.name: 줄거리 소개

areas.comment: 무섭지 않았다는 것과 작가를 존경한다는 생각은 좋아요. 다만 이야기 자체가 어땠는지(신났다, 감동했다 등)는 조금 부족해요.
areas.example: I felt so excited when Harry got his letter from Hogwarts.
areas.name: 나의 생각

areas.comment: 세 번이나 읽었는데 좋아하는 장면이나 인물이 하나도 나오지 않아요. 다인이가 가장 좋아하는 부분을 꼭 넣어 주세요.
areas.example: My favorite character is Hermione because she is smart and brave.
areas.name: 책 속 근거

areas.comment: 작가를 존경한다는 마무리는 인상적이에요. 여기에 이 책이 다인이에게 어떤 의미인지 한 문장 더하면 완벽해요.
areas.example: This book made me fall in love with reading long novels.
areas.name: 마무리

essay.mission: 세 번 읽으면서 매번 새롭게 느낀 점 하나를 써 보기
essay.overall: 구성이 탄탄한 독후감이에요. 다음엔 다인이만의 감상과 좋아하는 장면을 더해 보세요.

books.title: Oliver's Great Big Universe
books.author: Jorge Cham
books.original: This book always give me some knowledges about universe. I can't understand all but I hope I can understand someday. This is first book of the series. I really love this book because it's super funny so it always makes me laugh a lot. I love the main charecter. He always cause perblems. But that makes this books so funny. The most interested part of this book was <chapter 5 The Eight planets and, um, pluto.> Oliver and his friend made some comics about the planets. And it cause problem. Because of Uranus' pronounciation. You read it as "ur-A-nus," but it sound like "URah-nus" so it is easy to misunderstand that you're talking your butt. Thanks to Dr. Howard, who explained Uranus, Olivers can escape of the problem. Anyway, I really love this book, and I think the author of this book, Jorge cham is a genius
books.corrected: This book always gives me some knowledge about the universe. I can't understand all of it, but I hope I can understand it someday. This is the first book of the series. I really love this book because it's super funny, so it always makes me laugh a lot. I also love the main character. He always causes problems, but that makes this book so funny. The most interesting part of this book was Chapter 5, "The Eight Planets and, Um, Pluto." Oliver and his friend made some comics about the planets, and they caused a problem because of Uranus's pronunciation. You read it as "ur-A-nus," but it sounds like "URah-nus," so it is easy to think that you're talking about your butt. Thanks to Dr. Howard, who explained Uranus, Oliver could escape from the problem. Anyway, I really love this book, and I think the author of this book, Jorge Cham, is a genius.

corrections.explain: 주어가 This book(하나)이라 동사에 -s를 붙여요.
knowledge는 셀 수 없는 명사라 -s를 붙이지 않아요.
우주는 하나뿐이라 the universe라고 해요.

corrections.corrected: I can't understand all of it
corrections.explain: 무엇을 다 이해 못 하는지 all of it으로 분명히 해요.
first(첫 번째) 앞에는 the를 써요.
character의 철자를 확인해요.
He 뒤에는 causes, problems 철자도 확인해요.
this 뒤에는 단수 book이에요.
부분이 흥미를 주는 거라 interesting이에요.
지난 이야기라 caused, problem 앞에는 a가 필요해요.
pronounce와 달리 pronunciation에는 o가 하나 빠져요.
it 뒤에는 sounds예요.
‘~에 대해 말하다’는 talk about이에요.

corrections.corrected: Oliver could escape from the problem
corrections.explain: 이름에는 s를 붙이지 않고, ‘~에서 벗어나다’는 escape from이에요.
corrections.original: Olivers can escape of the problem

corrections.corrected: the author of this book, Jorge Cham, is a genius
corrections.explain: 이름은 대문자로, 설명하는 이름 양쪽에 쉼표를 찍어요.
corrections.original: the author of this book, Jorge cham is a genius

books.strengths: 가장 재미있었던 챕터를 정확히 짚고, 천왕성 발음 때문에 생긴 웃긴 상황을 구체적으로 설명해서 책의 재미가 잘 전해져요.
books.tips: 책에서 새로 알게 된 우주 지식 하나를 영어 한 문장으로 소개해 보면, 재미와 배움을 모두 담은 독후감이 돼요.

expressions.en: This book made me laugh out loud.
expressions.ko: 이 책 때문에 소리 내어 웃었어요.

expressions.en: I learned a lot about space from this book.
expressions.ko: 이 책에서 우주에 대해 많이 배웠어요.

expressions.en: My favorite part was when Oliver ...
expressions.ko: 가장 좋았던 장면은 올리버가 ~할 때였어요.

areas.comment: 책 소개, 좋아하는 이유, 가장 재밌었던 장, 작가 칭찬으로 자연스럽게 이어져요.
areas.name: 구성

areas.comment: 웃긴 장면은 자세하지만, 이 책이 전체적으로 누구의 어떤 이야기인지는 빠져 있어요. 첫 부분에 한 문장으로 소개해 주세요.
areas.example: This book is about Oliver, a curious boy who wants to learn everything about the universe.
areas.name: 줄거리 소개

areas.comment: 웃음이 난다는 것, 지금은 다 이해 못 해도 언젠가 이해하고 싶다는 마음이 솔직하고 멋져요.
areas.name: 나의 생각

areas.comment: 5장의 천왕성 발음 사건을 구체적으로 설명해서, 왜 웃긴지 읽는 사람도 바로 알 수 있어요. 아주 좋은 근거예요.
areas.name: 책 속 근거

areas.comment: ‘작가는 천재’라는 마무리가 재밌어요. 왜 천재라고 생각하는지 이유를 한 마디 붙이면 더 좋아요.
areas.example: He is a genius because he makes hard science easy and funny.
areas.name: 마무리

essay.mission: 책에서 새로 배운 우주 지식 하나를 영어 한 문장으로 소개해 보기
essay.overall: 구체적인 장면으로 책의 재미를 잘 보여 준 좋은 독후감이에요.

books.title: Oliver's Great Big Universe: Volcanoes Are Hot!
books.author: Jorge Cham
books.original: This book is about Earth Science like volcanoes. The story begans with introduceing his aunt. He said his aunt is a cave-woman. And I thought that was right. Because his aunt really looks like cave-woman. Anyway, Oliver ask to his aunt to help his science homework (that kind of thing) I thought that was like science competition. However, His work was not really good. In the other hand, he help his competitor to win. His behavior was kind and nice. I can learn about science and take a leaf out of oliver's books. And it was also funny like series one. I only read this book in Korean, so if I has a chace, I want to read this book in English. Plus, I really hope I can read next books of this series in English soon.
books.corrected: This book is about Earth science, like volcanoes. The story begins by introducing his aunt. He said his aunt is a cavewoman, and I thought that was right, because his aunt really looks like a cavewoman. Anyway, Oliver asks his aunt to help him with his science homework (that kind of thing). I thought it was like a science competition. However, his work was not really good. On the other hand, he helped his competitor win. His behavior was kind and nice. I can learn about science and take a leaf out of Oliver's book. It was also funny, like the first book in the series. I have only read this book in Korean, so if I have a chance, I want to read it in English. Plus, I really hope I can read the next books of this series in English soon.

corrections.explain: 예를 들 때 쓰는 like 앞에는 쉼표를 찍어요. science는 문장 중간이라 소문자가 자연스러워요.
begin은 현재형이 begins예요. begans라는 말은 없어요.
e로 끝나는 동사에 -ing를 붙일 때는 e를 빼요. ‘~하는 것으로 시작하다’는 begin by -ing예요.

corrections.corrected: and I thought that was right, because his aunt
corrections.explain: Because로 시작하는 문장은 혼자 쓸 수 없어서 앞 문장에 쉼표로 이어요.
corrections.original: And I thought that was right. Because his aunt

corrections.explain: cavewoman은 셀 수 있는 명사라 a가 필요해요. 붙여서 한 단어로 써요.
Oliver(한 명) 뒤에는 asks, ask 뒤에는 to 없이 바로 사람을 써요.

corrections.corrected: help him with his science homework
corrections.explain: ‘누구의 숙제를 돕다’는 help + 사람 + with + 일이에요.
competition은 셀 수 있는 명사라 a가 필요해요.
쉼표 뒤 문장 중간에서는 소문자로 써요.
‘반면에’는 in이 아니라 On the other hand예요.
지난 이야기라 helped, help 뒤에는 to 없이 win을 써도 돼요.
corrections.original: he help his competitor to win

corrections.corrected: take a leaf out of Oliver's book
corrections.explain: 이름은 대문자로! 이 관용 표현은 항상 book(단수)으로 써요.
corrections.original: take a leaf out of oliver's books

corrections.corrected: like the first book in the series
corrections.explain: ‘시리즈 1권’은 the first book in the series라고 해요.

corrections.corrected: I have only read this book in Korean
corrections.explain: ‘지금까지 한국어로만 읽었다’는 경험이라 have read예요.
corrections.original: I only read this book in Korean

corrections.explain: I 뒤에는 have, chance 철자에 n이 빠졌어요.
‘다음 권들’처럼 정해진 것 앞에는 the를 써요.

books.strengths: ‘take a leaf out of someone's book(본받다)’ 같은 어려운 관용 표현을 정확한 뜻으로 썼어요! 올리버가 경쟁자를 도운 행동을 보고 배운 점을 스스로 찾아낸 것도 훌륭해요.
books.tips: 올리버의 이모를 왜 동굴인이라고 부르는지 이유를 한 문장 붙이면, 읽는 사람이 재미있는 별명이라는 걸 바로 알 수 있어요.

expressions.en: This book is both educational and hilarious.
expressions.ko: 이 책은 배울 것도 많고 정말 웃겨요.

expressions.en: Oliver showed good sportsmanship by helping his rival.
expressions.ko: 올리버는 경쟁자를 도우며 멋진 스포츠맨십을 보여 줬어요.

expressions.en: I can't wait to read the next book in English.
expressions.ko: 다음 권을 영어로 빨리 읽고 싶어요.

areas.comment: 책 소개 → 줄거리 → 배운 점 → 다음 목표 순서로 흐름이 자연스러워요. 1권 독후감보다 훨씬 짜임새가 좋아졌어요.
areas.name: 구성

areas.comment: 이모와 과학 숙제 이야기가 나오지만, 첫 문장에 주인공 올리버가 소개되지 않고 ‘that kind of thing’처럼 흐릿한 부분이 있어요.
areas.example: This book is about Oliver, who asks his aunt for help with his science homework.
areas.name: 줄거리 소개

areas.comment: 올리버의 행동이 친절했다는 평가, 영어로 꼭 읽고 싶다는 바람이 분명하게 드러나요.
areas.name: 나의 생각

areas.comment: 경쟁자를 도운 장면이 핵심인데 어떻게 도왔는지는 빠져 있어요. 그 장면을 한두 문장으로 보여 주면 ‘친절했다’는 생각이 더 설득력 있어져요. 이모가 왜 동굴인 같은지도 이유를 붙여 주세요.
areas.example: One scene I remember is when Oliver helped his competitor, because it showed his kindness.
areas.name: 책 속 근거

areas.comment: 배운 점을 관용 표현으로 정리하고, 다음 권을 영어로 읽겠다는 목표로 마무리한 점이 아주 좋아요.
areas.name: 마무리

essay.mission: 다음엔 책에서 배운 과학 지식(예: 화산은 왜 폭발할까) 한 가지를 영어로 소개해 보기
essay.overall: ‘take a leaf out of ~’ 같은 멋진 표현까지 쓴, 한 단계 성장한 독후감이에요.

books.title: Space Case (Moon Base Alpha)
books.author: Stuart Gibbs
books.original: This series is my favorite series among the books that I read before. The author of this book is Stuart Gibbs. I am really big fan. I love his Spy School series, Which is awesome. I really really hope this book will made into movie series. That will be great! I asked Stuart Gibbs how about making this series into movie, and sadly, he answer that he was trying for 10 years to make this series into movie but that never happans. I was so upset when I saw that. Because the story is great enough to make movies. I think It will be really famouse. I don't want to tell about the stories of these books because are so boring. I think I wrote about this for more than 100 times. I introduce this book to my friends, parents, teachers (it's because I have to worte my reading log. I hate writing them because it's tired and boring also.) I will finish this. I have to go to sleep.
books.corrected: This series is my favorite series among the books that I have read. The author of this book is Stuart Gibbs. I am a really big fan. I also love his Spy School series, which is awesome. I really, really hope that this book will be made into a movie series. That would be great! I asked Stuart Gibbs about making this series into a movie, and sadly, he answered that he had been trying for 10 years to make this series into a movie, but it never happened. I was so upset when I saw that, because the story is great enough to be made into movies. I think it would be really famous. I don't want to tell the stories of these books because telling them is so boring. I think I have written about this more than 100 times. I have introduced this book to my friends, parents, and teachers (it's because I have to write my reading log. I hate writing them because it's tiring and boring.) I will finish this now. I have to go to sleep.

corrections.explain: ‘지금까지 읽어 본 책 중에서’는 현재완료(have read)로 써요.

corrections.corrected: I am a really big fan
corrections.explain: fan은 셀 수 있는 명사라서 앞에 a가 필요해요.
문장 중간에 오는 which는 소문자로 써요.

corrections.corrected: this book will be made into a movie series
corrections.explain: ‘영화로 만들어지다’는 수동태라서 be made가 되고, movie 앞에 a가 필요해요.
corrections.original: this book will made into movie series

corrections.explain: 아직 일어나지 않은 바람을 말할 때는 would가 더 자연스러워요.

corrections.corrected: about making this series into a movie
corrections.explain: ‘~에 대해 물었다’는 asked ~ about ~ 으로 써요.
corrections.original: how about making this series into movie

corrections.corrected: he answered that he had been trying for 10 years
corrections.explain: 지난 일이라 answered, 10년 동안 계속 노력해 온 건 had been trying이에요.
corrections.original: he answer that he was trying for 10 years

corrections.explain: happen의 철자와 과거형(happened)을 확인해요.

corrections.corrected: great enough to be made into movies
corrections.explain: 이야기가 영화를 ‘만드는’ 게 아니라 영화로 ‘만들어지는’ 거예요.
famous 끝에는 e가 없어요.

corrections.corrected: because telling them is so boring
corrections.explain: because 뒤에도 주어가 꼭 있어야 해요.

corrections.corrected: I have written about this more than 100 times
corrections.explain: 횟수 앞에는 for를 쓰지 않아요. 지금까지의 경험이라 have written이에요.
corrections.original: I wrote about this for more than 100 times

corrections.explain: write의 철자가 바뀌었어요.
내가 피곤한 건 tired, 일이 나를 피곤하게 하는 건 tiring이에요.

books.strengths: 좋아하는 작가에게 직접 질문하고 답을 받은 경험을 생생하게 써서 읽는 사람도 다인이의 팬심이 느껴져요. great enough to 같은 표현도 잘 썼어요.
books.tips: 다음에는 이 시리즈에서 가장 좋아하는 장면 하나를 골라 왜 영화로 보고 싶은지 2~3문장으로 설명해 보세요.

expressions.en: I'm a huge fan of Stuart Gibbs.
expressions.ko: 나는 스튜어트 기브스의 엄청난 팬이에요.

expressions.en: It would make a fantastic movie.
expressions.ko: 멋진 영화가 될 거예요.

expressions.en: I've recommended this book to everyone I know.
expressions.ko: 아는 사람 모두에게 이 책을 추천했어요.

books.summary: 최애 시리즈가 영화로 나오길 바라는 마음

areas.comment: 작가 이야기, 영화 바람, 독후감 쓰기 싫다는 이야기로 흐름이 여러 갈래로 흩어졌어요. ‘책 소개 → 좋은 이유 → 바람’ 순서로 정리하면 훨씬 읽기 쉬워요.
areas.example: First, I will tell you what this book is about.
areas.name: 구성

areas.comment: 책 내용이 한 줄도 없어서, 안 읽은 사람은 어떤 이야기인지 알 수 없어요. 주인공과 사건을 한두 문장으로만 소개해도 충분해요.
areas.example: Dash, a 12-year-old boy living on Moon Base Alpha, thinks a scientist's death was not an accident.
areas.name: 줄거리 소개

areas.comment: 작가를 정말 좋아하는 마음과 영화로 꼭 보고 싶다는 바람이 진심으로 전해져요. 작가에게 직접 물어본 경험도 아주 특별해요.
areas.name: 나의 생각

areas.comment: ‘영화로 만들 만큼 이야기가 좋다’고 했는데, 왜 좋은지 보여 주는 장면이 없어요. 가장 재밌었던 장면 하나만 넣어도 설득력이 확 올라가요.
areas.example: My favorite part was when Dash found the first clue, because I couldn't stop reading.
areas.name: 책 속 근거

areas.comment: ‘이제 자러 가야 한다’로 끝나서 독후감이 갑자기 멈춘 느낌이에요. 추천 한마디나 한 줄 정리로 끝내 보세요.
areas.example: If you like mysteries and space, you will love this series.
areas.name: 마무리

essay.mission: 다음 독후감에는 ‘가장 좋았던 장면’을 골라 3문장 이상 써 보기
essay.overall: 작가와 시리즈를 향한 애정은 최고예요! 이제 ‘왜 재밌는지’를 책 내용으로 보여 주면 멋진 독후감이 돼요.

books.title: Sunny Figures It Out
books.author: Jennifer L. Holm & Matthew Holm
books.original: This book is one of the <Sunny side up> series. The story is about Sunny's relationship with her friends. Sunny has a very close friend, and she's name is Deb. Deb is always interested in clothes, boys, and something like these. Deb thinks Sunny and Tony has something. She thinks they're cauple. So Tony and Sunny's relationship became awkward as they try to conform to it. In the end up the story, Sunny and Tony are friends. I liked the ending of the story because I hated Deb's thinking. I think Sunny is trying so hard to conform Deb's thinking. Altough she don't have to conform it. But it was good that Sunny was always with her friends or family. She is not alone. I can feel doldrums and the warmth of people when I am reading this book.
books.corrected: This book is one of the Sunny Side Up series. The story is about Sunny's relationships with her friends. Sunny has a very close friend, and her name is Deb. Deb is always interested in clothes, boys, and things like that. Deb thinks Sunny and Tony have something going on. She thinks they're a couple. So Tony and Sunny's relationship becomes awkward as they try to conform to it. At the end of the story, Sunny and Tony are still friends. I liked the ending of the story because I didn't like Deb's way of thinking. I think Sunny is trying so hard to conform to Deb's thinking, although she doesn't have to. But it was good that Sunny was always with her friends or family. She is not alone. I can feel the doldrums and the warmth of people when I am reading this book.

corrections.explain: she's는 she is의 줄임말이에요. ‘그녀의’는 her예요.
‘그런 것들’은 things like that이 자연스러워요.
두 사람이 주어라 have를 써요.
couple 철자를 확인하고 앞에 a를 붙여요.

corrections.corrected: relationship becomes awkward as they try
corrections.explain: 한 문장 안에서는 시제를 맞춰요(현재 이야기면 becomes).
corrections.original: relationship became awkward as they try

corrections.corrected: At the end of the story
corrections.explain: ‘이야기 끝부분에서’는 At the end of the story예요.
corrections.original: In the end up the story

corrections.explain: conform은 to와 함께 써요.
although 문장은 혼자 쓸 수 없어 앞 문장에 붙이고, she 뒤에는 doesn't예요.
corrections.original: Altough she don't have to conform it.

corrections.explain: doldrums는 보통 the와 함께 써요.

books.strengths: conform, awkward, doldrums 같은 수준 높은 단어를 정확한 뜻으로 썼어요. 결말이 왜 좋았는지 자기 생각도 분명하게 밝혔어요.
books.tips: 써니라면 데브에게 뭐라고 말했을지, 또는 다인이라면 어떻게 했을지 한두 문장 더해 보면 생각이 더 잘 드러나요.

expressions.en: Sunny feels pressure to go along with her friend.
expressions.ko: 써니는 친구 뜻에 따라야 한다는 부담을 느껴요.

expressions.en: True friends don't have to change for each other.
expressions.ko: 진짜 친구는 서로를 위해 바뀔 필요가 없어요.

expressions.en: The book shows both loneliness and warmth.
expressions.ko: 이 책은 외로움과 따뜻함을 함께 보여 줘요.

books.summary: 친구 생각에 맞추려 애쓰는 써니 이야기

areas.comment: 시리즈 소개 → 인물 관계와 사건 → 결말 → 내 생각 순서로 잘 정리됐어요.
areas.name: 구성

areas.comment: 써니, 데브, 토니의 관계와 갈등을 핵심만 뽑아 잘 설명했어요.
areas.name: 줄거리 소개

areas.comment: 결말이 왜 좋았는지, 써니가 굳이 맞출 필요가 없었다는 의견이 분명해요.
areas.name: 나의 생각

areas.comment: 써니가 데브의 생각에 맞추려고 어떤 행동을 했는지 장면이 하나 있으면 의견이 더 설득력 있어져요.
areas.example: One scene that shows this is when Sunny acts differently around Tony because of what Deb said.
areas.name: 책 속 근거

areas.comment: ‘외로움과 따뜻함을 느꼈다’는 마무리가 좋아요. 이 책에서 배운 점을 한 문장 더하면 완성이에요.
areas.example: This book taught me that I don't have to change myself for my friends.
areas.name: 마무리

essay.mission: ‘내가 써니라면 데브에게 뭐라고 했을까?’를 써 보기
essay.overall: 수준 높은 단어와 분명한 의견이 돋보이는, 다섯 편 중 가장 균형 잡힌 독후감이에요.

books.title: Wonder
books.author: R.J. Palacio
books.original: I will going to write one more because I have lots of books that I want to read. There are so many books I haven't read yet. I love graphic novels, novels (such as non-fiction, science-fiction) And this book is novel. The story of this book is really wonderful. The main charector has strange face. When I first read that part introducing his face, I read that part with pity. However, when I read that part for second time, there no more pity. I thought he is brave and kind person.
books.corrected: I am going to write one more because I have lots of books that I want to read. There are so many books I haven't read yet. I love graphic novels, novels (such as science fiction), and non-fiction, and this book is a novel. The story of this book is really wonderful. The main character has an unusual face. When I first read the part introducing his face, I read it with pity. However, when I read that part for the second time, there was no more pity. I thought he was a brave and kind person.

corrections.explain: will과 be going to 중 하나만 써요.

corrections.corrected: novels (such as science fiction), and non-fiction
corrections.explain: 논픽션은 실제 이야기라 소설(novel)의 한 종류가 아니에요. 따로 써요.
novel은 셀 수 있는 명사라 a가 필요해요.
character의 철자를 확인해요.
strange는 ‘이상한’이라 차갑게 들려요. unusual/different가 이 책의 마음에 더 맞아요.
‘두 번째’ 앞에는 the를 써요.
there 뒤에 동사 was가 빠졌어요.

corrections.corrected: I thought he was a brave and kind person
corrections.explain: 앞이 과거(thought)라 was, person 앞에 a가 필요해요.
corrections.original: I thought he is brave and kind person

books.strengths: 처음 읽을 때와 두 번째 읽을 때 마음이 어떻게 달라졌는지 쓴 부분이 정말 좋아요. 이 책이 말하려는 것을 잘 느꼈다는 증거예요.
books.tips: 공책 첫 장이 ‘think I’에서 끊겨 있어요. 다음 장이 있다면 사진을 원본 파일에 추가하고 원문을 이어서 입력해 주세요.

expressions.en: At first I felt sorry for him, but then I admired him.
expressions.ko: 처음엔 안쓰러웠지만, 나중엔 그를 존경하게 됐어요.

expressions.en: Auggie is braver than anyone I know.
expressions.ko: 어기는 내가 아는 누구보다 용감해요.

expressions.en: This book taught me to choose kindness.
expressions.ko: 이 책은 친절을 선택하라고 가르쳐 줬어요.

books.summary: 두 번 읽고 달라진 어기에 대한 마음

areas.comment: ‘읽을 책이 많아서 하나 더 쓴다’로 시작해 책과 관계없는 도입이 길어요. 바로 책 소개로 시작해 보세요. 글이 아직 끝나지 않은 점도 있어요.
areas.example: Wonder is a story about a boy named Auggie.
areas.name: 구성

areas.comment: 어기가 어떤 아이이고 무슨 일이 일어나는지(처음 학교에 가는 이야기)가 빠져 있어요.
areas.example: Auggie, a boy with a different face, goes to school for the first time in fifth grade.
areas.name: 줄거리 소개

areas.comment: 처음엔 안쓰러웠다가 두 번째엔 그런 마음이 사라졌다는 변화가 이 책의 핵심을 정확히 짚었어요. 아주 훌륭해요.
areas.name: 나의 생각

areas.comment: 어기가 왜 용감하고 친절하다고 생각했는지 장면이 있으면 좋아요.
areas.example: He was brave because he went to school even though people stared at him.
areas.name: 책 속 근거

areas.comment: 글이 ‘think I’에서 멈춰 있어요. 이 책에서 배운 점으로 마무리해 보세요.
areas.example: This book taught me to choose kindness.
areas.name: 마무리

essay.mission: 어기에게 하고 싶은 말을 한 문장으로 쓰며 독후감을 마무리하기
essay.overall: 감정의 변화를 포착한 시선이 정말 좋아요. 끝까지 완성하면 최고의 독후감이 될 거예요.

books.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Partypooper
books.author: Jeff Kinney
books.original: I always love this series. It's really funny so that I laugh loud. The main charecter Greg is very unfortunat boy I every seen in my 11 years life. He has two brother, and his oldest brother always make fun of him, and his younger brother always so lucky. But I think Greg is not very kind and nice. He is very Selfish, and doesn't have any manner. There are many manner Greg should think about.
books.corrected: I have always loved this series. It's so funny that I laugh out loud. The main character, Greg, is the most unfortunate boy I have ever seen in my 11 years of life. He has two brothers. His oldest brother always makes fun of him, and his younger brother is always so lucky. But I think Greg is not very kind or nice. He is very selfish and doesn't have any manners. There are many manners Greg should think about.

corrections.corrected: I have always loved this series
corrections.explain: 예전부터 지금까지 쭉 좋아해 온 마음은 현재완료(have loved)로 써요.

corrections.corrected: so funny that I laugh out loud
corrections.explain: ‘너무 ~해서 ~하다’는 so + 형용사 + that이에요. ‘소리 내어 웃다’는 laugh out loud예요.
corrections.original: really funny so that I laugh loud

corrections.explain: Wonder, Oliver 독후감에서도 같은 실수가 있었어요. char-ac-ter로 끊어 외워 보세요.
이름으로 앞말을 설명할 때는 이름 양쪽에 쉼표를 찍어요.

corrections.corrected: is the most unfortunate boy I have ever seen
corrections.explain: ‘내가 본 중에 가장 ~한’은 최상급 the most를 쓰고, 경험은 have ever seen이에요.
corrections.original: is very unfortunat boy I every seen

corrections.explain: unfortunate 끝에 e가 있어요.
‘지금까지’는 ever, every는 ‘모든’이라는 다른 단어예요.
‘11년 동안의 삶’은 years 뒤에 of를 넣어요.
둘 이상이면 -s를 붙여요.

corrections.corrected: oldest brother always makes fun of him
corrections.explain: 주어가 형 한 명이라 makes예요.
corrections.original: oldest brother always make fun of him

corrections.corrected: his younger brother is always so lucky
corrections.explain: 문장에 동사가 빠졌어요. is를 넣어야 해요.
corrections.original: his younger brother always so lucky

corrections.explain: not 뒤에서 두 가지를 이을 때는 and 대신 or를 써요.
문장 중간의 일반 단어는 소문자로 써요.
‘예절’이라는 뜻일 때는 항상 manners로 써요.
many 뒤에는 복수형 manners가 와요.

books.strengths: 주인공을 무조건 좋아하지 않고 ‘불운하지만 이기적이다’라고 양쪽을 다 본 점이 아주 훌륭해요. make fun of, selfish 같은 표현도 정확한 뜻으로 썼어요.
books.tips: character 철자를 세 번째 독후감에서도 charecter로 썼어요. 다음 독후감 쓰기 전에 char-ac-ter를 세 번 써 보고 시작해 보세요.

expressions.en: Greg is unlucky, but he is also selfish.
expressions.ko: 그렉은 운이 없지만 이기적이기도 해요.

expressions.en: I laughed out loud on almost every page.
expressions.ko: 거의 모든 쪽에서 소리 내어 웃었어요.

expressions.en: Greg should learn to think about other people's feelings.
expressions.ko: 그렉은 다른 사람의 마음을 생각하는 법을 배워야 해요.

areas.comment: 시리즈 소개 → 인물 소개 → 그렉에 대한 생각으로 흐름은 좋아요. 다만 이번 20권만의 이야기가 빠지고 글이 짧게 끝났어요.
areas.example: In this book, Greg tries to ___, but it doesn't go well.
areas.name: 구성

areas.comment: 그렉의 가족 소개는 시리즈 전체 이야기라, 《Partypooper》에서 무슨 일이 있었는지는 알 수 없어요. 이번 권 사건을 한두 문장으로 써 주세요.
areas.example: This book is about what happens when Greg ___.
areas.name: 줄거리 소개

areas.comment: ‘불운한 아이’라고 동정만 하지 않고 ‘이기적이고 예절이 없다’는 자기 판단을 분명히 밝혔어요. 생각이 깊은 독후감이에요.
areas.name: 나의 생각

areas.comment: 그렉이 이기적이라고 했는데, 어떤 행동을 보고 그렇게 느꼈는지 장면이 없어요. 장면 하나만 있어도 의견이 훨씬 설득력 있어져요.
areas.example: For example, Greg ___, and he didn't even say sorry.
areas.name: 책 속 근거

areas.comment: ‘그렉이 생각해야 할 예절이 많다’로 끝나는데, 어떤 예절인지 하나만 짚어 주면 좋은 마무리가 돼요.
areas.example: If Greg learned to say thank you, people would like him more.
areas.name: 마무리

essay.mission: 그렉이 이기적이었던 장면 하나를 골라 ‘For example, ...’로 시작하는 문장 2개 쓰기
essay.overall: 주인공을 비판적으로 본 시선이 돋보여요. 이번 권의 사건과 장면을 더하면 다인이 생각이 훨씬 빛날 거예요.
